sources.title: Fee Structure of IIT (BHU) — 4-Year B.Tech./B.Pharm. and 5-Year IDD/B.Arch., w.e.f. Session 2019-20 onwards (still the current UG schedule on the DOAA fee page)

scholarships.name: SC/ST/PwD Tuition & Hostel Seat-Rent Waiver
scholarships.eligibility: All regular SC, ST and PwD-category students (including OBC-PD/SC-PD/ST-PD) admitted to the 4-year B.Tech/B.Pharm or 5-year IDD/B.Arch programmes at IIT (BHU).
scholarships.benefit: Full exemption from the semester tuition fee and the hostel seat-rent charge; the remaining semester dues (mess, gymkhana, medical, utilities, etc.) still apply as for other students.

sources.title: Fee Structure of IIT (BHU), Session 2019-20 onwards — footnote on SC/ST/PwD tuition and seat-rent exemption

scholarships.name: Family-Income-Based Tuition Concession
scholarships.eligibility: GEN/OBC/EWS B.Tech, B.Pharm, IDD and B.Arch students whose family income is below Rs 5 lakh a year, as declared and verified at admission.
scholarships.benefit: Students with family income under Rs 1 lakh a year pay no semester tuition fee; those with income between Rs 1-5 lakh pay about one-third of the standard tuition (roughly Rs 33,333 instead of Rs 1,00,000 per semester).

sources.title: Fee Structure of IIT (BHU), Session 2019-20 onwards — tuition-fee slabs by family income

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students selected on a combination of academic merit and demonstrated family financial need; the scheme is designed to cover up to about 25 percent of the UG student body.
scholarships.benefit: A need-linked scholarship stipend administered by the Dean of Academic Affairs office; the payout amount is set for each academic session and was not published with a figure on the institute's page at the time of collection.

sources.title: DOAA — Scholarships/Financial Assistance (Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for ~25% of UG students)

scholarships.name: SC/ST Free Studentship, Mess Reimbursement & Pocket Allowance
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes categories.
scholarships.benefit: Institute free-studentship (tuition waiver), reimbursement of mess charges, and a monthly pocket allowance, administered by the Dean of Academic Affairs office alongside the Top Class Education Scheme routed through the National Scholarship Portal.

sources.title: DOAA — Scholarships/Financial Assistance (SC/ST free studentship, mess-charge reimbursement, pocket allowance)
